tasks.title: The Arts and Crafts Movement in the United States
paras: The Arts and Crafts Movement in the United States was responsible for sweeping changes in attitudes toward the decorative arts, then considered the minor or household arts. Its focus on decorative arts helped to induce United States museums and private collectors to begin collecting furniture, glass, ceramics, metalwork, and textiles in the late nineteenth and early twentieth centuries. The fact that artisans, who were looked on as mechanics or skilled workers in the eighteenth century, are frequently considered artists today is directly attributable to the Arts and Crafts Movement of the nineteenth century. The importance now placed on attractive and harmonious home decoration can also be traced to this period, when Victorian interior arrangements were revised to admit greater light and more freely flowing spaces.

The Arts and Crafts Movement reacted against mechanized processes that threatened handcrafts and resulted in cheapened, monotonous merchandise. Founded in the late nineteenth century by British social critics John Ruskin and William Morris, the movement revered craft as a form of art. In a rapidly industrializing society, most Victorians agreed that art was an essential moral ingredient in the home environment, and in many middle- and working-class homes craft was the only form of art. Ruskin and his followers criticized not only the degradation of artisans reduced to machine operators, but also the impending loss of daily contact with handcrafted objects, fashioned with pride, integrity, and attention to beauty.

questions.stem: What is the main idea of the passage?

options.A: The Arts and Crafts Movement influenced how people viewed handmade objects in a modern society.
options.B: The Arts and Crafts Movement led to the decline of industrial production in the nineteenth century.
options.C: The Arts and Crafts Movement was mainly concerned with collecting decorative art in museums
options.D: The Arts and Crafts Movement focused on developing a naturalistic artistic style.

questions.analysis: 题型：主旨题 正确答案：A. The Arts and Crafts Movement influenced how people viewed handmade objects in a modern society. 原文定位：第一段指出该运动“was responsible for sweeping changes in attitudes toward the decorative arts”。 正确答案分析：文章聚焦该运动如何改变人们对手工艺和工匠的态度。 选项分析： B 没有提到工业衰退；尽管有反机械化倾向，但不是核心内容。 C 收藏活动是影响之一，但不是整篇主旨。 D 没有提到自然主义风格的艺术发展或否定。

questions.stem: It can be inferred from the passage that the Arts and Crafts Movement would have considered all of the following to be artists EXCEPT

options.B: people who produce handmade glass objects
options.C: operators of machines that automatically cut legs for furniture
options.D: metalworkers who create handcrafted decorative objects

questions.analysis: 题型：推理题 正确答案：C. operators of machines that automatically cut legs for furniture 原文定位：“criticized... artisans reduced to machine operators”，说明这类工人不被视为艺术家。 选项分析： A 是纺织品设计者，属手工艺范畴。 B 手工玻璃制作者也属于该运动推崇的工匠类型。 C 是正确答案，机械操作工被批评，代表非手工创作。 D 手工金属装饰品符合对“pride, integrity, beauty”的追求。

questions.stem: The word "revered" in the passage is closest in meaning to
questions.analysis: 题型：词汇题 正确答案：A. respected 原文定位：“the movement revered craft as a form of art” 表明该运动对手工艺的高度推崇。 正确答案分析：revered 与 respected 含义相近，都表示尊重和敬仰。 选项分析： A. respected（尊敬的）——正确，对应语境中“推崇手工艺为艺术”。 B. described（描述的）——错误，不符合表示态度或情感的语气。 C. avoided（回避的）——错误，与推崇完全相反。 D. created（创造的）——错误，revered 表示评价而非创作行为。

questions.stem: According to the passage, which of the following changes occurred at the same time as the Arts and Crafts Movement?

options.A: The creation of brighter and more airy spaces inside homes
options.B: The rejection of art that depicted nature in a realistic manner
options.C: A decline of interest in art museum collections
options.D: An increase in the buying of imported art objects

questions.analysis: 题型：细节题 正确答案：A. The creation of brighter and more airy spaces inside homes 原文定位：“Victorian interior arrangements were revised to admit greater light and more freely flowing spaces.” 正确答案分析：文章明确指出家庭内部空间设计变化与该运动同时发生。 选项分析： B 未提到自然主义艺术风格的变化。 C 收藏活动在该运动中反而增加，不是减少。 D 没有提到对进口艺术品兴趣的任何信息。

questions.stem: According to the passage, what was a key criticism made by John Ruskin and his followers?

options.A: The Arts and Crafts Movement was too focused on British traditions.
options.B: Mechanization was reducing artisans to machine operators and eliminating daily contact with handcrafted objects.
options.C: Victorian homes lacked sufficient moral value in their decoration.
options.D: Museums were not collecting enough decorative arts from working-class artisans.

questions.analysis: 答案：B 解析：最后一段明确指出：“Ruskin and his followers criticized not only the degradation of artisans reduced to machine operators, but also the impending loss of daily contact with handcrafted objects, fashioned with pride, integrity, and attention to beauty.” 这直接对应了选项 B 的描述。
